audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male speaker's energetic, medium-pitched voice introducing a holiday theme over a bright, high-tempo electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 kick drum. (2) A sharp transition SFX leads to a series of quick vocal exchanges with various guests; voices overlap with moderate ambient chatter and restaurant background noise. (3) A loud, exaggerated "YA!" shout creates a peak in vocal arousal, accompanied by a rhythmic synth swell in the BGM. (4) The audio texture shifts as the speaker enters a more crowded banquet setting, where the frequency of background laughter and clinking sounds increases. (5) A series of short, questioning vocal responses from different people are punctuated by "pop" and "whoosh" sound effects that emphasize the fast visual cuts. (6) The video concludes with a high-pitched, sustained vocal scream/shout that dominates the mix, followed by a final comedic sound effect as the music continues to play through the end.
